adjudicators.reasoning: The OpenMP content is fine, as Reading A says, but the base-language program is not. gs1 in the submodule is defined with a full function-stmt (MODULE prefix plus dummy argument list). Under Fortran 2008/2018 (separate module procedures, 12.6.2.5 / 15.6.2.5) such a definition is an ordinary procedure body whose dummy argument x must be declared in it, and implicit none forbids leaving x undeclared; only the abbreviated MODULE PROCEDURE form inherits the interface. Reading B is correct, so acceptance is not required and the hang is not shown to be a violation.

Reading A fails: the OpenMP parts are fine, but the submodule defines gs1 with a full function-stmt, so the dummy argument x must be declared in the function body. With implicit none and no declaration of x (nor a module procedure statement form), the Fortran program violates the base-language rules. A non-conforming program need not be accepted, so the hang is not a required-result failure. Reading B is right.
